stem.text: A combined heat and power (CHP) station generates electrical power and useful heat. The diagram shows the input and output powers for a CHP station.

stem.alt: Arrow diagram: an input arrow labelled input power from fuel divides into three output arrows labelled wasted power 60 MW, useful heating power 160 MW and useful electrical power 100 MW.

stem.text: What is the efficiency of the CHP station for producing useful power?
